    toc: false
  apaquarto-docx: default
  apaquarto-typst: default

<!--
list-of-contents asks for a table of contents in all four formats, in the
place the other two lists go.

Each format gets there differently. typst has an outline of its own and took
toc: true before this; the pdf has latex's tableofcontents, with its lines
flattened to the shape the lists use; .docx is built by hand, since pandoc's
own contents field cannot be moved off the top of the file; and .html has
neither pages nor a field, so an entry is the heading and a link to it.

Quarto's toc: true still puts a contents in the .html margin. This one is
part of the document.
-->
